description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations. The x-axis represents TFLOPs, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, on a logarithmic scale, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one order of magnitude. The y-axis represents Loss Ratio (%), ranging from 94% to 99%, on a linear scale. The plot contains five lines: the 'Vanilla' model is shown as a purple line with triangle markers and a solid line; the 'SepLLM (n=64)' model is shown as an orange line with circle markers and a solid line; the 'SepLLM (n=128)' model is shown as a blue line with cross markers and a solid line; the 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' model is shown as a green line with diamond markers and a solid line; and the 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' model is shown as a red line with circle markers and a solid line. The 'Vanilla' line starts at approximately 99.5% and remains nearly constant at that level. The 'SepLLM (n=64)' line starts at approximately 98.5% and increases to a peak of approximately 99.6% at 4e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The 'SepLLM (n=128)' line starts at approximately 97% and rises steadily to approximately 99.5% at 4e8 TFLOPs before leveling off. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' line starts at approximately 97.5% and rises to approximately 99.5% at 4e8 TFLOPs before stabilizing. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' line starts at 94% and increases sharply to approximately 98.5% at 1e8 TFLOPs before leveling off near 98.5%.
